sloka: विरराज समीपस्थम् सागरस्य तु तद् बलम् ।मधु पाण्डु जलः श्रीमान् द्वितीय इव सागरः ॥६-४-१०७॥।।
transliteration: virarāja samīpastham sāgarasya tu tad balam ।madhu pāṇḍu jalaḥ śrīmān dvitīya iva sāgaraḥ ॥6-4-107॥।।

translations.english: That vast (sea of) army of monkeys in tawny colour (settled) at the proximity of the sea (that was white) seemed like a prosperous second sea in bright colour.
